links.comparator_used: Single end-to-end LLM performing extraction, SCORE2 calculation and risk classification (post hoc deterministic SCORE2 recalculation applied to model-extracted variables)
links.outcome: Agreement (quadratic-weighted kappa) with expert-assigned final ESC risk category
links.effect: End-to-end best model GPT-4o κw 0.69 (95% CI 0.44-0.84); with deterministic recalculation using model-extracted variables, κw 0.85-0.90 across all models
links.quote: this markedly improved agreement across all models (κw 0.85-0.90), demonstrating that extraction was largely intact and computational execution was the primary failure mode.

design_hint: deterministic recalculation of risk score outside the LLM
